items.prompt: An order has filled 30 of 100 shares. After a cancel request, 20 more fill before cancel confirmation. How much can the final cancel remove if nothing else happens?

options.why: A request does not reverse the extra 20 fills.
The cancel applies to remaining open shares.
Cumulative fill 50 plus cancellation 50 leaves open 0.

options.text: Zero because partial fills always disable cancellation
options.why: That is not the stated protocol.

items.explanation: Only the unfilled remainder can be canceled in this synthetic sequence.
